title: Why AI Isn't Going to Become Conscious
speaker: Anil Seth
summary_zh: 神经科学家 Anil Seth 论证 AI 永远不会产生意识——我们将内心生活投射到机器上，就像在云朵中看到人脸。他剖析了人类拟人化倾向为何让我们误入歧途，并给出对「AI 会觉醒吗」这一紧迫问题的明确否定。
summary_en: Neuroscientist Anil Seth argues that AI will never become conscious — we project inner life onto machines just as we see faces in clouds. He explores why our tendency to anthropomorphize leads us astray and gives a definitive answer to the urgent question: Will AI ever gain consciousness?
